testcase.name: Scenario: Fit a distant block using Zoom All: tmp/obk-zoom-48987af/features/application/viewport-zoom/viewport-zoom.feature:29:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Fit a distant block using Zoom All ✔ Given a rectangular block is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the block appears small within the viewport ✔ When the user opens the Zoom menu on the navigation bar ✔ Then the menu offers Zoom, Zoom All, Zoom Window and Zoom Selected ✔ When the user chooses Zoom All ✔ Then the block appears larger and its visible outline fits within the viewport ✔ And the same part and orientation remain active ✔ When the user reopens the Zoom menu ✔ Then Zoom All is marked as the selected action ✔ When the user selects Zoom and presses Escape ✔ Then the status area displays Ready
